data.notes: February 2026 in London was especially strong for electronic music, with major warehouse-scale Drumsheds shows, fabric programming, KOKO club nights, and big-room concerts.

events.title: ANOTR at KOKO
events.summary: Dutch house duo ANOTR played a one-off KOKO Electronic night, with the venue billing it as an intimate return after sold-out shows.

events.title: fabric Continuum: Ellen Allien, Oscar Mulero, Adiel, X CLUB., Quest B2B Quelza, Daria Kolosova
events.summary: fabric’s first Continuum of 2026 ran as a 25-hour techno session with Ellen Allien, Oscar Mulero, Adiel, X CLUB., Quest B2B Quelza and Daria Kolosova among the bill.

events.title: Mathame All Night Long at KOKO
events.summary: Italian melodic techno duo Mathame played an all-night-long KOKO theatre session, promoted by the venue as a rare intimate UK show.

events.title: Jayda G, Bibi Seck, Helena Star at KOKO
events.summary: Jayda G returned to KOKO with Bibi Seck and Helena Star for an Electronic Nights programme focused on dancefloor-led house and electronic music.

events.title: Herrensauna 10 Years at FOLD
events.summary: Berlin collective Herrensauna celebrated 10 years at FOLD with CEM, JASSS, MCMLXXXV, SALOME, Slim Soledad, Twang and ZACKITO on the lineup.

events.title: Giolì & Assia at KOKO
events.summary: Italian duo Giolì & Assia made their KOKO theatre debut with a live/DJ-led sound blending techno, house, indie and pop elements.

events.title: Teletech XXL at DRUMSHEDS
events.summary: Teletech, The Warehouse Project and Broadwick Live brought a large-scale hard-techno showcase to DRUMSHEDS, with Azyr B2B BLK., Fantasm, Holy Priest, MarcelDune, Novah B2B Hannah Laing and many more.

events.title: anyone can dance: Eastern Margins at the Barbican
events.summary: The Barbican launched its anyone can dance late-night party series with an Eastern Margins-curated night featuring Nick Cheo, KOLLIN, Jianbo and MEYY.

events.title: DJ Marky & Friends at KOKO
events.summary: DJ Marky & Friends took over KOKO for a daytime event celebrating drum & bass, jungle and Marky’s Brazilian-rooted global club sound.

events.title: FAC51 The Haçienda at DRUMSHEDS
events.summary: FAC51 The Haçienda staged its biggest indoor show to date at DRUMSHEDS, headlined by Groove Armada, Haçienda Classical, Deep Dish, Roger Sanchez, Inner City and other house-music figures.

events.title: Eastenderz at DRUMSHEDS
events.summary: Eastenderz returned to London for its biggest showcase yet at DRUMSHEDS, with house and tech-house names led by East End Dubs, Hot Since 82, Kolter, Jamback, Laidlaw and Cristina Lazic.

events.title: Fred again.. USB002 Residency at Alexandra Palace
events.summary: Fred again.. continued his USB002 London residency at Alexandra Palace, with the official label press release listing 12, 13, 26 and 27 February 2026 London dates.
